value.rationale: The exact normal-error coefficient gives an operational local mean-square risk budget for the two-sided oblique projection in sketched dynamical low-rank approximation. It exhibits a genuine integrability phase transition at ell=r+1 and a nonzero limit of 3 for ell=2r as r grows, even on rank-one normal residuals; thus proportional sketch oversampling does not wash out local normal-residual coupling. This sharp boundary clarifies a mathematically motivated numerical-method failure mode that qualitative OSE-based comparisons do not quantify. It is deliberately limited to local projection error, not global solver stability.
